hub.title: Storage Units on the Fylde Coast | The Rock Factory
hub.desc: Storage and small units in central Blackpool for people across the Fylde coast, from Fleetwood to Lytham. Compare unit sizes and find your area guide.
hub.lead: The Rock Factory is one building in central Blackpool, on Keswick Road off Park Road. People come to us from all along the coast, so these guides help you decide whether a unit here makes sense from where you live or work.

sections.h2: One building, many neighbourhoods
sections.html:
We are not a chain and we do not have branches. Everything we let is under one roof at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB. That is central Blackpool, a short way inland from the Tower and the seafront.

The Fylde coast is a long, narrow strip, though. Fleetwood sits at the northern tip, Lytham faces the Ribble estuary at the southern end, and Poulton-le-Fylde is inland. A unit that suits someone in Layton may be a less obvious choice for someone in Fleetwood. So rather than pretend every postcode is the same, we have written a separate guide for each area, with honest notes on what to weigh up.

Before you commit to anything, look up your own route to The Rock Factory on Google Maps. Only you know how often you will visit and how you will get here.

sections.h2: Find the guide for your area
sections.html:
Blackpool neighbourhoods

  • Storage for South Shore: flats, terraces, guest houses and seasonal businesses near the Pleasure Beach end of town.
  • Storage for North Shore and Bispham: larger family homes, downsizers and the hotels along the northern promenade.
  • Storage for Layton: tradespeople, home workers and busy family streets on the inland side of town.
  • Storage for Marton: suburban homes, renovations and clubs around the Stanley Park side of Blackpool.

Fylde borough

  • Storage for St Annes: online sellers, small shops and family homes in St Annes-on-the-Sea.
  • Storage for Lytham: furniture, period-home projects and event businesses.

Wyre borough

  • Storage for Poulton-le-Fylde: newer homes short on space and home businesses ready to move out.
  • Storage for Thornton-Cleveleys: bungalow living, downsizing and hobby space.
  • Storage for Fleetwood: longer-term storage and workspace for people at the northern tip of the coast.

sections.h2: A store near home or a unit in central Blackpool?
sections.html:
There is no single right answer, and we would rather you chose well than chose us. These are the questions that usually decide it:

  • How often will you visit? If you will be in and out every day, the journey matters a great deal. If you will visit once a month, it matters far less.
  • What are you storing? A van-load of furniture is a one-off trip. Stock you pick from daily is a different job.
  • Do you need workspace or just storage? Many self-storage sites offer storage only. Our units have power and Wi-Fi, and business use is possible with prior approval.
  • When do you need access? We offer 24-hour access, so early starts and late finishes are fine.
  • How long are you committing for? Our minimum term is one month, then one month's notice.

If you are still deciding on size, our guide on choosing the right size of storage unit will help.

sections.h2: What we do not do
sections.html:
We want these area guides to be straight with you, so here is what we do not offer:

  • We do not collect from your home or deliver to it. You bring your things to Keswick Road yourself, or use a removals firm of your choice.
  • We have no other sites. If you see a Rock Factory page mentioning your area, it is about people from that area using our Blackpool building.
  • We do not store cars, and some activities are not allowed in the building. Our guide to what not to store explains why.

sections.h2: Moving in from anywhere on the coast
sections.html:
Units are available from 1 November 2026, and pre-bookings get the first week free. The steps are the same wherever you come from:

  1. AskTell us what you want to store or do, and we will suggest a unit.
  2. ViewArrange a viewing so you can see the space and judge the journey for yourself.
  3. PaperworkBring valid government-issued photo ID and sign a Direct Debit mandate.
  4. Pay and move inOne month's rent in advance plus a security deposit equal to one month's rent.

For questions, viewings or a pre-booking, message us on WhatsApp. The full details are on our rental terms page.

faqs: Do you have storage sites in other Fylde towns?
No. The Rock Factory is a single building on Keswick Road, off Park Road, in central Blackpool (FY1 5PB). Our area pages are for people elsewhere on the coast who are weighing up a unit here.
How far is The Rock Factory from my home?

We do not quote distances or journey times, because they depend on where you start and how you travel. Look up your route on Google Maps using our full address: The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB.
Can you pick up my things from St Annes, Poulton or Fleetwood?
No, we do not offer collection or delivery. You move your own things in, or arrange a removals firm, and we give you 24-hour access once you are a tenant.
Which unit is best if I only have a few boxes?
Our ground-floor units start at 150 sq ft. For small amounts, the first-floor storage pods opening in spring 2027 may suit better, with guide prices from £10 a week (to be confirmed).

pages.title: Storage for South Shore, Blackpool | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage units and small business units in central Blackpool for South Shore homes, guest houses and seasonal traders. Rolling monthly, 24-hour access.
h1: homes, guest houses and seasonal trade
pages.lead: South Shore is a busy mix of terraced streets, flats, guest houses and businesses that live by the summer season. If space at home or work is tight, this guide helps you judge whether a unit at The Rock Factory in central Blackpool is the right fit.

sections.h2: Who in South Shore tends to need extra space
sections.html:
South Shore runs from the southern end of the promenade, with the Pleasure Beach and South Pier, back through rows of terraced houses and converted flats. It is a part of town where space is often in short supply.

The people who usually look for storage or a small unit here include:

  • Guest house and holiday flat owners who need somewhere for spare bedding, linen, replacement furniture and decorating materials, especially during a refit between seasons.
  • People living in flats with no loft, garage or shed, who need a home for bikes, camping gear, seasonal clothes or furniture they are not ready to part with.
  • Seasonal traders whose stock and kit sits idle for part of the year and takes over the house when it does.
  • Tenants between homes, which is common in an area with a lot of rented property.

sections.h2: A note for guest house and holiday-let owners
sections.html:
If you run accommodation, you know the pattern. In the busy months every room earns its keep, so nothing can be stored in one. Then the quieter months arrive and it is time for repairs, repainting and new furniture, which all need somewhere to go while the work happens.

A 150 sq ft roller-shutter unit at £65 a week (about £282 a month) gives you a dry, lit space to hold spare mattresses, linen stock and furniture during a refit. When the work is done you can give one month's notice, or keep the unit and swap to a different size, subject to availability. If the refit is a bigger job, our guide to storage during a renovation covers planning and packing.

Business use of a unit needs our prior approval, so tell us how you plan to use it when you enquire.

sections.h2: Seasonal businesses and stock
sections.html:
Plenty of livelihoods in this part of town follow the visitor calendar. If your stock, stall equipment or signage lives in your hallway over winter, a unit can give you your home back and keep everything in one place for the next season.

For bulkier kit, the 180 sq ft unit at £78 a week has a roller shutter for loading. Our guide to running a seasonal business in Blackpool and the page on units for market traders have more ideas. Rent is rolling monthly, so you are not tied into a long lease through the quiet months if your plans change.

sections.h2: Living in a flat with nowhere to put things
sections.html:
Many South Shore homes are flats carved out of larger houses, and they rarely come with a loft or a shed. The result is familiar: a bike in the hall, a suitcase on the wardrobe, the Christmas decorations under the bed.

A good rule is to keep at home what you use every week, and store what you use a few times a year. Things that often move out happily include:

  • Camping, fishing and sports kit used on a handful of weekends.
  • Winter or summer clothes and bedding, packed in sealed boxes.
  • Furniture you are keeping for a bigger home later.
  • Paperwork you must keep but rarely look at.

Our guide on how to pack a storage unit shows how to fit it all in so the things you need are at the front.

sections.h2: Choosing between a store near you and central Blackpool
sections.html:
There may be storage options closer to your street. It is worth comparing honestly rather than defaulting to the nearest one. Things to check, wherever you look:

  • Access hours. We offer 24-hour access, which matters if you work evenings or weekends in season.
  • Power and Wi-Fi. Ours are connected in every unit. Electricity is charged at the supplier rate with no markup, and there are no utility deposits.
  • Contract length. We ask for one month minimum, then one month's notice.
  • Whether you can work there. Many stores are storage only. With prior approval, our units can be used as a workspace too.
  • The full monthly cost, including any deposit, insurance or admin fees elsewhere. Our deposit is equal to one month's rent.

Our guide to how storage prices work explains what to compare line by line.

sections.h2: Where we are in relation to South Shore
sections.html:
The Rock Factory is at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB. That is in central Blackpool, inland from the town centre seafront, rather than in South Shore itself.

We do not quote distances or journey times, because they depend on exactly where you start and how you travel. Please check your route from South Shore on Google Maps before you decide, and think about the trips you will actually make: one big move-in, or frequent visits.

We do not collect or deliver. You bring your things in yourself or book a removals firm.

sections.h2: Getting started
sections.html:
Units are available from 1 November 2026, and if you pre-book you get the first week free. To move in you will need one month's rent in advance, a security deposit equal to one month's rent, valid government-issued photo ID and a signed Direct Debit mandate.

If you would like to talk it through or book a viewing, message us on WhatsApp. You can also read our frequently asked questions first.

faqs: Can I store guest house furniture and bedding in a unit?
Yes. Furniture, mattresses, linen and other dry household goods are fine. Keep mattresses and soft furnishings covered and off the floor, and avoid storing anything damp.
Can I store a car from my South Shore home?
No. Car storage is not permitted at The Rock Factory because of our buildings insurance. Bikes, garden kit and household items are fine.
Is there a minimum contract for seasonal storage?
The minimum term is one month. After that it rolls monthly and you give one month's notice when you want to leave, so you can match it to your season.
Do you have a site in South Shore?
No. We have one building, on Keswick Road off Park Road in central Blackpool. Check your route on Google Maps using postcode FY1 5PB.

pages.title: Storage for North Shore & Bispham | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage in central Blackpool for North Shore and Bispham households: downsizing, family belongings and hotel refits. Rolling monthly, 24-hour access.
h1: Storage for North Shore and Bispham
pages.lead: North Shore and Bispham have more than their share of larger family homes, and plenty of people there are downsizing, clearing a parent's house or refitting a hotel. Here is how to decide whether a unit in central Blackpool helps.

sections.h2: What makes North Shore and Bispham different
sections.html:
Heading north from North Pier, the promenade climbs onto the cliffs, past the Gynn and on towards Bispham. Behind the seafront hotels are streets of bigger semi-detached and detached houses, many of them family homes for decades.

That shapes the reasons people need storage here. It is less often about a lack of space day to day, and more often about a change: the children have left, a move to somewhere smaller is coming, or a relative's home needs clearing. Hotel owners along the northern stretch of the promenade have their own needs during refits and the quieter months.

sections.h2: Downsizing without rushing decisions
sections.html:
Moving from a four-bedroom house to a flat or bungalow means letting go of a lot. The hardest part is often not the move but deciding what to keep. Storage gives you time to make those decisions calmly instead of on removal day.

  1. Sort into three groupsComing with you, definitely going, and not sure yet.
  2. Move the "not sure" group into storageLabel every box clearly, with a list kept at home.
  3. Live in the new home for a few monthsYou will soon learn what you miss and what you do not.
  4. Decide, then give noticeRehome, sell or fetch what is left, then give one month's notice on the unit.

For more on this, see our guides on decluttering with the help of storage and storage when moving house.

sections.h2: Clearing a family home
sections.html:
When someone has to clear a parent's or relative's house, there is often a deadline from a landlord, a sale or an estate. A unit can hold furniture, photographs, papers and keepsakes while the family decides what to do, without anyone being pushed into a quick decision.

If the belongings include important paperwork, our guide to storing documents and archives has tips on boxing and labelling. For furniture, our furniture storage guide explains how to protect wood and upholstery.

Please remember that insurance is not included in our rent. Check whether your home contents policy covers items in storage, or arrange cover separately. Our storage insurance guide explains the options in general terms.

sections.h2: Getting a house ready to sell
sections.html:
If you are selling a larger home in this part of town, buyers will want to picture their own lives in it. Rooms full of furniture, books and collections can make a house look smaller than it is, and they make photographs harder to take well.

Moving some of it out before the photographs and viewings is a common approach. Typical candidates are extra chairs and side tables, a spare bed in a box room, bookshelves, and anything stored in the garage that buyers would like to see empty. It also means much of your packing is done before the sale goes through.

Because our rent is rolling monthly, you are not left paying for a long contract if the sale moves faster or slower than expected.

sections.h2: For hotels on the northern promenade
sections.html:
Hotels and guest houses on this side of town often need somewhere to put furniture during a room-by-room refurbishment, or to hold spare stock out of season.

The 300 sq ft two-storey unit at £130 a week (about £563 a month) has a roller shutter downstairs and an upstairs area with a window, reached by an internal staircase. That upstairs space can work as a small office for paperwork while the ground floor holds furniture and supplies. Business use needs our prior approval.

sections.h2: Local storage or a unit in central Blackpool
sections.html:
Before choosing anywhere, picture how you will actually use the space. A downsizing move might mean one large drop-off and a handful of visits. A hotel refit might mean regular trips over several weeks.

  • Will you need to get in outside normal hours? We have 24-hour access.
  • Will a relative or helper need to come with you? Check how access works at any site you consider.
  • Would you rather unload through a wide roller shutter or walk in through a door? We have both: roller-shutter units at 150 and 180 sq ft, and a 160 sq ft unit with a security door.
  • Are you happy with a rolling monthly arrangement? Ours is one month minimum, then one month's notice.

If you only have a few boxes, wait for our first-floor storage pods, opening in spring 2027 at guide prices from £10 a week. They are reached by stairs.

sections.h2: Finding us from North Shore or Bispham
sections.html:
We are in one building only: The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We have no presence in North Shore or Bispham, and we do not collect or deliver.

Because every starting point is different, we do not give journey times. Plan your route from home on Google Maps and, if you like, message us on WhatsApp to arrange a viewing so you can see the space before committing.

faqs: Can I keep a deceased relative's belongings in a unit while the estate is sorted?

Yes. Household furniture, papers and personal belongings are fine to store. The tenant must provide valid photo ID and a Direct Debit mandate, and the rent is rolling monthly so you can give notice when you are ready.
Is my furniture insured while it is in storage?
Insurance is not included in the rent. Check your home contents policy or take out separate cover before you move items in.
Which unit is easiest for loading heavy furniture?
The 150 sq ft and 180 sq ft units and the two-storey unit have roller shutters, which make large items easier to move in. All units are on the ground floor.
Can I move to a smaller unit once I have sorted through things?
Yes, you can swap to a bigger or smaller unit at any time, subject to availability.

pages.title: Storage & Trade Units for Layton | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Small units in central Blackpool for Layton tradespeople, home workers and families short on space. From £65 a week, rolling monthly, 24-hour access.
pages.lead: Layton is a busy residential part of inland Blackpool, home to plenty of tradespeople, home workers and growing families. If tools, stock or household overflow are taking over, here is how to think about a unit at The Rock Factory.

sections.h2: Layton homes and the space squeeze
sections.html:
Much of Layton is made up of terraced and semi-detached streets. They are practical family homes, but a garage, if there is one, is usually full within a year or two, and the loft is often hard to reach with anything heavier than a box of decorations.

When people from Layton ask us about space, it tends to be one of three things: a trade that has outgrown the van and the garage, a job done from the back bedroom that now needs a proper room, or a household with too much stuff and nowhere to put it. Each needs a slightly different unit, so we will take them in turn.

sections.h2: For tradespeople: get the materials out of the house
sections.html:
Plumbers, electricians, joiners, decorators and builders often keep stock and tools at home. That can mean ladders in the hall, offcuts in the garden and a van that has to be loaded from the pavement each morning.

A roller-shutter unit gives you one place for all of it. The 150 sq ft unit at £65 a week suits tools, fittings and smaller materials. The 180 sq ft unit at £78 a week (about £338 a month) gives more floor for timber, boxed kitchens or kit you rotate between jobs. With 24-hour access you can collect what you need before an early start.

A few practical limits apply. We do not allow bulk flammable liquids or gases unless agreed in writing, which includes fuel, solvent-based paints and gas cylinders. Wood, fittings, tiles, dry goods and hand tools are fine. There is standard single-phase power only, so check that any equipment you want to run will work on it.

Our page on unit ideas for trades goes into more detail.

sections.h2: For home workers who need a door to close
sections.html:
Working from a spare room is fine until it is not. Perhaps the family needs the room back, or you need to meet clients somewhere other than your kitchen.

The 160 sq ft unit has a security door rather than a roller shutter, which makes it feel more like a room than a garage. It is windowless, but it has lighting, power and Wi-Fi connected. Tenants can receive mail and clients at the unit, and there is a shared tea and coffee room and toilets. If you would prefer natural light, our two offices at £70 a week each will be available from January 2027 after refurbishment.

Our guide on working comfortably in a windowless unit is worth a read before you decide, and so is moving your business out of your home.

sections.h2: For families with a full garage
sections.html:
Bikes, garden furniture, the cot that might be needed again, boxes from the last move: it builds up. Before renting anything, it is worth a weekend of sorting, because storing things you do not want is money spent for nothing.

If you still need the space after that, a ground-floor unit or, from spring 2027, one of our first-floor storage pods or rooms may suit. Pods and rooms are reached by stairs and are at guide prices still to be confirmed, from £10 a week for a 15 sq ft pod. Our storage unit versus garage guide compares the two honestly.

sections.h2: Comparing a unit here with options nearer Layton
sections.html:
You may find industrial units or storage options closer to your street. Comparing like with like is the key. Ask each place:

  • Is power included and how is usage charged? Ours is charged at the supplier rate with no markup.
  • Is there Wi-Fi, and is it already connected? Ours is.
  • How long is the lease? Many commercial units ask for years. Ours is rolling monthly after a one-month minimum.
  • Can you use the address on your Google Business Profile? Our tenants can.
  • Can you grow into a bigger space without moving site? You can swap units here, subject to availability, and some units interconnect.

Business rates may apply to commercial units. Ask us about the specific unit, and check the official guidance on Small Business Rate Relief, linked below.

sections.h2: Getting here from Layton
sections.html:
The Rock Factory is in central Blackpool at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, FY1 5PB. We are not in Layton and we do not collect or deliver.

We do not state journey times, because they vary with where you start, the time of day and how you travel. Check the route from your Layton address on Google Maps and think about it as a daily trip if you are a tradesperson or home worker, not just a one-off.

sections.h2: Starting out
sections.html:
Units are available from 1 November 2026 and pre-bookings get the first week free. All business use needs prior approval, so tell us what you do when you get in touch. To move in, bring valid government-issued photo ID, sign a Direct Debit mandate and pay one month's rent in advance plus a deposit equal to one month's rent.

For a viewing, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs: Can I store a van-load of building materials?
Yes, as long as they are not bulk flammables such as fuel, solvent-based paints or gas cylinders, unless agreed in writing. Timber, tiles, fittings and dry materials are fine.
Can I run power tools in the unit?
Every unit has standard single-phase electricity, not three-phase. Light workshop use may be possible with our prior approval, so ask us about what you plan to do.
Can I use the unit as my business address?
Yes. Tenants can receive mail at the unit and can use the Rock Factory address on their Google Business Profile.
Do you have a site in Layton?
No. Our only building is on Keswick Road, off Park Road, in central Blackpool FY1 5PB.

pages.title: Storage for Marton, Blackpool | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage and small units in central Blackpool for Marton families, renovators, clubs and groups. Rolling monthly terms, 24-hour access, from £65 a week.
pages.lead: Marton is suburban Blackpool: family homes, extensions in progress, and lots of clubs and groups that need somewhere for their kit. This guide looks at whether a unit at The Rock Factory in central Blackpool fits your plans.

sections.h2: Marton and the reasons people look for space
sections.html:
Marton covers a wide stretch of south-east Blackpool, with the green space of Stanley Park on one side and the Marton Mere nature reserve further out. The A583, Preston New Road, runs through the area and connects to junction 4 of the M55.

The housing is mostly suburban semis, bungalows and detached homes. People here are less likely to be desperate for basic space and more likely to need room for a project: a loft conversion, a new kitchen, a growing family, or a club whose kit has been living in someone's garage for years.

sections.h2: Extensions, kitchens and loft conversions
sections.html:
Home improvement projects are a common reason Marton households rent storage. When builders need a room empty, the contents have to go somewhere, and a garage full of furniture is soon a garage full of dust.

  • Plan the timing. Projects often overrun. Rolling monthly rent means you only pay for the months you use, with one month's notice when you leave.
  • Protect furniture properly. Use breathable covers rather than sealed plastic for wood and upholstery.
  • Keep a list. Note which boxes hold what, so you are not searching for the kettle on week three.
  • Think about access. 24-hour access means you can fetch things in the evening after work.

Our full guide to storage during a renovation covers this step by step.

sections.h2: Bikes, sports kit and family overflow
sections.html:
With parks and open spaces around, many Marton families have bikes, scooters, camping gear, paddleboards and garden furniture. Most of it is used in summer and is in the way for the rest of the year.

For a household that just needs a bit of overflow space, a ground-floor unit may be more than you need. Our storage pods and rooms, opening on the first floor in spring 2027, come in sizes from a 15 sq ft pod to a 100 sq ft room, at guide prices from £10 to £34 a week (to be confirmed). They are reached by stairs, so heavy items are better in a ground-floor unit. See also our guide to seasonal storage.

sections.h2: When the garage becomes a room
sections.html:
Converting an attached garage into a study, playroom or extra bedroom is a popular way to add space to a suburban home. The catch is that everything the garage used to hold still needs somewhere to live: the lawnmower, tools, paint tins, Christmas decorations and the boxes nobody has opened since the last move.

Before you rent anything, sort it. Some of it can go to the tip or a charity shop. Some belongs in a garden shed. What is left, the things you genuinely use but not every week, is what a storage unit is for.

A couple of cautions. Leftover tins of solvent-based paint, fuel for the mower and gas cylinders are not allowed in bulk at The Rock Factory unless agreed in writing, so dispose of them properly or keep them in a suitable outdoor store. Hand tools, garden furniture, boxed decorations and DIY materials such as timber are fine.

Our guide to what not to store has the full list and the reasons behind it.

sections.h2: For clubs, teams and community groups
sections.html:
Sports teams, dance schools, scout and guide groups, amateur dramatics and other community groups all have the same problem: kit, costumes and equipment with no permanent home. Often it ends up spread across several members' houses.

A shared unit can bring it all together. A roller-shutter unit makes it easier to load nets, staging or display boards. You can also receive mail at the unit. Our page on units for clubs and community groups has ideas on sharing the cost and organising access. Ask us on WhatsApp how a group can rent a unit: move-in needs valid government-issued photo ID and a signed Direct Debit mandate.

sections.h2: What to compare before you choose
sections.html:
It is natural to look for something as close to home as possible. That makes sense for things you need often. For a renovation or seasonal kit, the trip matters less than the terms. Weigh up:

sections.h2: Where we are, and checking your route
sections.html:
Our building is at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool rather than in Marton. We have no other sites and do not offer collection or delivery.

We will not guess at journey times for you. See your route from Marton on Google Maps and, when you are ready, send us a WhatsApp message to arrange a viewing. Units are available from 1 November 2026, with the first week free if you pre-book.

faqs: How long can I keep things in storage during building work?
As long as you need. After the one-month minimum the rent rolls monthly, and you give one month's notice when the work is finished.
Can a sports club rent a unit?
Yes, with our prior approval for the use. One named person signs up with valid photo ID and a Direct Debit mandate, and the club can share the cost however it likes.
Can I store a mobility scooter or e-bike?
Bikes and household items are fine. For anything with a large battery, ask us on WhatsApp first so we can talk it through.
Can I store petrol mowers or fuel cans from the garden?
Bulk fuel is not allowed unless agreed in writing. Ask us before bringing anything that contains fuel.

pages.title: Storage & Small Units for St Annes | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage and small business units in central Blackpool for St Annes online sellers, shops and households. Rolling monthly, from £65 a week.
pages.lead: St Annes has its own character, a separate council and plenty of small businesses run from home. If you are thinking about a unit in central Blackpool, here is what to consider, starting with whether the journey makes sense for you.

sections.h2: St Annes, a different town next door
sections.html:
St Annes-on-the-Sea sits on the coast south of Blackpool, part of Fylde borough rather than Blackpool. It is known for its pier, Ashton Gardens, its sand dunes and the Royal Lytham & St Annes golf course. The A584 runs along the coast from St Annes up into Blackpool.

Its housing ranges from large Victorian and Edwardian houses, some now split into flats, to family homes and retirement flats. There is a strong small-business community too: independent shops in the town centre and plenty of people running businesses from a spare room.

sections.h2: For online sellers who have run out of room
sections.html:
Selling online often starts with a few boxes in the spare room. Then the stock grows, the packaging grows, and the spare room becomes the warehouse, the photo studio and the post room all at once.

A unit can separate the business from your home. Some practical points that matter for online sellers:

  • Wi-Fi is already connected, so you can list, print labels and answer messages at the unit.
  • You can receive mail at the unit, which helps with supplier deliveries and returns.
  • Shelving goes up easily in a windowless unit, as every wall is usable.
  • 24-hour access lets you pack orders in the evening if that is when you have time.

The 160 sq ft security-door unit at £69 a week (about £299 a month) suits sellers who mainly carry boxes. Our page on unit ideas for online sellers has layout ideas.

sections.h2: For St Annes shops needing a stockroom
sections.html:
Small shops rarely have the back-of-house space they would like. Extra stock for Christmas, display fittings for the next season and archive paperwork all compete for the same cupboard.

A roller-shutter unit can act as an off-site stockroom. Take seasonal stock in and out as you need it, and give one month's notice if you no longer need the space. Our guide comparing units, shops and coworking may help if you are weighing up your options more widely.

sections.h2: Moves into flats and smaller homes
sections.html:
St Annes is a popular place to settle, and many people move into flats or retirement properties here from larger houses elsewhere. Flats rarely have a garage or loft, so a lifetime of belongings has to fit into fewer rooms.

Storage can bridge the gap. It is common to keep a few pieces of good furniture, family papers and things for the grandchildren while you see how the new home works. Give yourself a review date, perhaps three or six months in, so storage does not quietly become permanent.

If you have a few boxes rather than a room's worth, our first-floor storage pods open in spring 2027, at guide prices from £10 a week. They are up a flight of stairs, so bear that in mind for heavier items. Our guide to decluttering with storage has more ideas.

sections.h2: Business rates when the unit is in Blackpool
sections.html:
One point that is easy to miss: business rates are billed by the council for the area where the property is. If your home is in St Annes but your unit is at The Rock Factory, any rates on the unit would be a Blackpool Council matter, not a Fylde Council one.

Rates may or may not apply depending on the unit and your circumstances, so ask us about the particular unit you are interested in. Small Business Rate Relief exists for smaller properties. The details are on GOV.UK, linked below, and our guide to business rates on small units explains the basics. Always check the official guidance for your own situation.

sections.h2: Storage in St Annes or a unit in central Blackpool?
sections.html:
For many people, the honest answer depends on how often they need to visit. A household storing furniture for six months might visit a few times. An online seller might be there daily. The more often you go, the more weight you should give to the route.

Other points to compare, whichever you choose:

  • Whether the site allows business use and client visits. Ours does, with prior approval.
  • Whether you can work there with power and Wi-Fi, or only store.
  • How long you are tied in. We are rolling monthly after one month.
  • Whether you can add space next door later. Some of our units interconnect.

sections.h2: Our location and your route from St Annes
sections.html:
We have one building: The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We have no presence in St Annes, and we do not collect or deliver.

Please check your route from St Annes on Google Maps before deciding. We do not quote distances or journey times, because they depend on where you start and how you travel.

sections.h2: When you are ready
sections.html:
Units are available from 1 November 2026, and pre-bookings get the first week free. You will need valid government-issued photo ID, a signed Direct Debit mandate, one month's rent in advance and a deposit equal to one month's rent.

To ask a question or arrange a viewing, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs: I live in St Annes. Which council handles business rates on a Rock Factory unit?

Business rates are billed by the council where the property is, so for a unit in our Blackpool building that would be Blackpool Council. Ask us about the specific unit, and check GOV.UK for the official guidance.
Can I have parcels delivered to my unit?
Yes. Tenants can receive mail at the unit.
Can I list my unit address on Google for my online shop?
Yes. Tenants may use the Rock Factory address on their Google Business Profile.
Is there a Rock Factory in St Annes?
No. There is one building, on Keswick Road off Park Road in central Blackpool.

pages.title: Storage for Lytham Homes & Firms | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage and business units in central Blackpool for Lytham households, furniture projects and event businesses. From £65 a week, rolling monthly.
pages.lead: Lytham is a small, elegant town at the southern end of the Fylde coast, with period homes, independent shops and a busy events calendar. This guide covers when a unit at The Rock Factory in central Blackpool might be useful to you, and when it might not.

sections.h2: Lytham and the kind of storage it calls for
sections.html:
Lytham looks out over the Ribble estuary, with the famous white windmill on Lytham Green and Lytham Hall set in parkland on the edge of town. It is part of Fylde borough, and the A584 links it along the coast with St Annes and Blackpool.

Storage needs here tend to be about quality as much as quantity. Good furniture during a house move, contents during work on an older property, stock for independent businesses and equipment for the many events held in and around the town. If any of those sound familiar, read on.

sections.h2: Work on an older home
sections.html:
Older houses bring older problems: rewiring, damp treatment, replastering, new windows. Much of that work needs rooms emptied completely, sometimes for weeks.

If you are moving valued furniture out of the way, a few habits protect it:

  • Wrap polished wood in breathable blankets, not tight plastic that traps moisture.
  • Stand mirrors and framed pictures upright, on their edges, never flat with weight on top.
  • Take legs off tables where you can, and keep the fixings in a labelled bag taped to the table.
  • Raise rugs and upholstery off the floor on pallets or boards.

Our furniture storage guide goes into more detail. Insurance is not included in our rent, so check what your home policy covers away from the house, and read our storage insurance guide.

sections.h2: For event hire and wedding businesses
sections.html:
Lytham is known for its summer festival on Lytham Green and for weddings and functions across the area. Behind those events are small businesses with a lot of kit: chair covers, backdrops, flower stands, lighting, signage, props and furniture.

That kind of equipment is bulky, comes and goes in batches and needs to be loaded fast. A roller-shutter unit is the practical choice. The 180 sq ft unit at £78 a week gives a good floor area. If you also need somewhere to do the admin, the two-storey unit at £130 a week pairs a ground-floor store with an upstairs area that has a window.

With 24-hour access, late returns after an evening event are not a problem. Our page on unit ideas for event hire looks at layout and rotation of stock.

sections.h2: Furniture restoration and upcycling
sections.html:
Some people who come to us are restoring and reselling furniture, often working from a garage that is no longer big enough. A unit can provide the floor space.

Be aware of our rules. Low-risk materials such as wood, fabric and card are fine. Bulk solvent-based paints and chemicals are not allowed unless agreed in writing, and all business use needs prior approval, so tell us what finishes and tools you plan to use. Water-based paints are worth considering.

See our furniture upcycling ideas for more.

sections.h2: Independent shops, studios and home stagers
sections.html:
Lytham's town centre is full of independent shops, galleries and salons, and plenty of interior designers and home stagers work in the area too. What they share is a lack of back-of-house space and stock that changes with the seasons.

An off-site unit can work as an overflow stockroom or a props store. A few ways people use one:

  • Holding Christmas or summer stock until the shop floor has room for it.
  • Keeping display fittings, mannequins and window props between campaigns.
  • Storing a stager's furniture, lamps, cushions and artwork between properties.
  • Keeping archived business paperwork out of a small shop's office.

Shelving makes the most of a windowless unit, as every wall is usable. If you need to move stock in and out often, think carefully about the trip, and see our guide to units, shops and coworking compared for the wider picture.

sections.h2: Weighing up a unit in central Blackpool
sections.html:
Lytham is at the far southern end of the Fylde coast from Blackpool town centre, so the journey is a real factor. Be honest with yourself about how often you will make it.

A unit here tends to make the most sense for Lytham people when:

  • You will visit occasionally rather than daily, as with furniture during building work.
  • Your work already takes you around the Fylde, as with event set-ups at different venues.
  • You want power, Wi-Fi and a workspace, not just a locked box.
  • You want a short commitment: one month minimum, then one month's notice.

If you need to pop in several times a day, something closer to home may serve you better, and that is fine.

sections.h2: Where to find us
sections.html:
Our only building is The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We are not in Lytham, and we do not collect or deliver.

Open the route from Lytham in Google Maps to see how it looks from your address. We do not quote distances or journey times. For a viewing, contact us on WhatsApp. Units are available from 1 November 2026 and pre-bookings get the first week free.

faqs: Can I store antique furniture at The Rock Factory?
Yes, furniture is fine. Insurance is not included, so check your own cover before moving valuable pieces, and pack wood and upholstery in breathable covers.
Can I load event equipment late at night?
Yes. Tenants have 24-hour access, and roller-shutter units make loading bulky kit easier.
Can I spray-paint furniture in a unit?
Bulk solvent-based paints are not permitted unless agreed in writing, and all business use needs prior approval. Ask us on WhatsApp about your methods before you sign up.
Is there somewhere to work on admin at the unit?

Every unit has lighting, power and Wi-Fi connected. The two-storey unit has an upstairs area with a window, and there is a shared tea and coffee room. Separate offices at £70 a week each will be available from January 2027.
Can I rent a unit just for the festival season?
Yes. The minimum term is one month, then it rolls monthly until you give one month's notice, so a summer-only arrangement works.
Do you have a unit in Lytham?
No. All our units are in one building on Keswick Road, off Park Road, in central Blackpool.

pages.title: Storage for Poulton-le-Fylde | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage and small business units in central Blackpool for Poulton-le-Fylde households and home businesses. Rolling monthly, 24-hour access.
pages.lead: Poulton-le-Fylde is an inland market town with a historic centre and plenty of newer homes around it. If you are short of space at home, or your business has outgrown the house, this guide helps you decide whether a unit in central Blackpool fits.

sections.h2: About Poulton and its storage needs
sections.html:
Poulton-le-Fylde sits inland, east of Blackpool, in Wyre borough. Its old market place and church give the centre a traditional feel, while much of the town is family housing, from older semis to more recent estates. The A586 links Poulton with central Blackpool.

The questions we hear from Poulton tend to be practical: where can the business stock go, how do we cope during a move, and what do we do with things that do not fit in a newer house?

sections.h2: Newer homes, less storage
sections.html:
Many newer homes are designed around open living spaces. They look great, but there is often less built-in storage than in older houses, garages can be narrow, and loft space may be limited or not boarded.

If that sounds like your home, it helps to separate what you need nearby from what you only need sometimes. Keep the everyday things at home. Things that suit storage include:

  • Spare furniture from a previous, larger house.
  • Baby and toddler equipment you are keeping for later.
  • Garden furniture and outdoor toys over winter.
  • Archive boxes of household and business paperwork.

For small amounts, our first-floor storage pods and rooms open in spring 2027 at guide prices from £10 a week. For more, start with a 150 sq ft ground-floor unit.

sections.h2: When the home business needs its own space
sections.html:
Plenty of Poulton households run a small business from home: a craft business at the kitchen table, a repair service in the garage, an online shop in the box room. At some point it starts to crowd out family life.

Signs it may be time to move the work out:

  • Stock or tools have spread into rooms meant for other things.
  • You would rather customers or couriers did not come to your home address.
  • You find it hard to switch off when work is always in the next room.

Our units come with lighting, power and Wi-Fi connected, and tenants can receive mail and clients. You can also use the Rock Factory address on your Google Business Profile. Our guide on moving your business out of your home walks through the decision, and unit ideas for tech and repair suits anyone fixing devices or electronics.

sections.h2: Gaps between completion dates
sections.html:
Moving within or out of Poulton often involves a chain, and dates do not always line up. If you have to leave one house before you can enter the next, a unit can hold your furniture in between.

  1. Book earlyUnits are available from 1 November 2026, and pre-bookings get the first week free.
  2. Load in onceAsk your removals firm to deliver to the unit. We do not collect or deliver ourselves.
  3. Fetch what you needWith 24-hour access you can collect essentials whenever you like.
  4. Leave on noticeGive one month's notice once you are settled.

Our full guide to storage when moving house has a packing checklist.

sections.h2: Market stalls and craft fairs
sections.html:
A market town naturally has its share of stallholders, and many Poulton people trade at markets, craft fairs and pop-up events across the Fylde and beyond. The problem is the same for all of them: gazebos, trestle tables, weights, display stands and boxes of stock that fill the car and the hallway between events.

A unit can become the place you load from. Pack the stall kit in one corner, stock on shelves in another, and keep a checklist on the wall so nothing is forgotten on market morning. With 24-hour access, early starts are no problem.

A roller-shutter unit makes loading quicker than carrying everything through a door. Our guides on selling at Blackpool markets and units for market traders have more practical tips. If you sell food, remember that cooking and hot food are not allowed in our units.

sections.h2: Local storage or central Blackpool: how to decide
sections.html:
If you visit often, a short journey is worth a lot. If you visit rarely, the terms and the space itself may matter more. Ask any provider you are comparing:

  • Can I work in the unit, or only store?
  • Is power metered fairly? We charge at the supplier rate with no markup.
  • What is the minimum term? Ours is one month.
  • Are there extra fees or deposits for utilities? We have none.

For running a business from a unit, check whether business rates apply. Ask us about the specific unit, and see our guide to business rates on small units and the official GOV.UK guidance below.

sections.h2: Where we are
sections.html:
The Rock Factory is at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We are not based in Poulton and have no presence there.

Check your route from Poulton on Google Maps, since we do not quote distances or journey times. When you would like to see a unit, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs: Can I have clients visit me at the unit?
Yes. Tenants can receive clients and mail at the unit, and there is a shared tea and coffee room and toilets. All business use needs our prior approval.
Will my removals firm be able to deliver straight to the unit?
Yes, you can arrange for them to deliver to your unit. Roller-shutter units make large items easier, and all units are on the ground floor.
Can I have more than one unit if my business grows?
Some units have interconnecting doors, so you can rent two or three adjoining units, subject to availability.
Can I sell food from my market stock unit?
Dry, packaged goods can be stored, but cooking and hot food are not allowed in the units. Ask us on WhatsApp about anything else food-related before you sign up.
How much is the 180 sq ft unit per month?
It is £78 a week, which works out at about £338 a month (78 × 52 ÷ 12), with electricity charged separately at the supplier rate.
Is The Rock Factory in Poulton?
No. We are in central Blackpool, on Keswick Road off Park Road, FY1 5PB.

pages.title: Storage for Thornton-Cleveleys | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Storage and hobby or workspace units in central Blackpool for Thornton-Cleveleys residents and mobile businesses. From £65 a week, rolling monthly.
pages.lead: Thornton-Cleveleys combines a seaside town with a quieter inland side, and lots of homes there are bungalows with limited storage. This guide looks at who might use a unit at The Rock Factory in central Blackpool, and what to weigh up first.

sections.h2: Thornton-Cleveleys in brief
sections.html:
Cleveleys has its seafront promenade and shopping streets, and the tramway runs through it on the way to Fleetwood. Thornton, inland, is home to Marsh Mill, the restored windmill. The A585 runs between the two on its way north to Fleetwood. The whole area is part of Wyre borough.

It is a popular place to retire to and to bring up a family, and there are plenty of bungalows. That mix creates some specific storage needs.

sections.h2: Bungalow life and the missing upstairs
sections.html:
A bungalow has many advantages, but it usually means fewer rooms and often a loft that is awkward or unsafe to climb into. For people who have moved from a house, the belongings that used to fill a spare bedroom and a loft now have nowhere obvious to go.

Storage can help, but it is worth being selective. Ask of each item: will I use this, will someone in the family want it, or am I keeping it out of habit? Things worth storing are those with a clear future, such as furniture promised to a grandchild, or Christmas things you bring out every year.

Our ground-floor units have no steps to climb inside them, which suits bulky or heavy items. The storage pods opening in spring 2027 are on the first floor and reached by stairs, so they suit lighter boxes. See our guide to decluttering with storage too.

sections.h2: Helping a parent move somewhere smaller
sections.html:
Often it is the adult children who look for storage, not the person moving. If you are helping a parent move into a bungalow, flat or care setting, storage can take some of the pressure off a stressful time.

  1. Agree what matters mostAsk which pieces they want around them in the new home, and start there.
  2. Do not decide everything at onceStore what the family needs time to think about, rather than rushing it to a clearance firm.
  3. Keep paperwork separateWills, deeds and financial papers deserve their own clearly labelled box.
  4. Share the listSend everyone in the family a copy of what is in storage, so decisions can be made together.

The person who signs up becomes the tenant and needs valid government-issued photo ID and a Direct Debit mandate.

sections.h2: Room for a hobby
sections.html:
Retirement is often when a hobby finally gets the space it deserves: woodwork, model railways, sewing, painting, restoring bikes. In a bungalow, that space may not exist at home.

A unit with lighting, power and Wi-Fi can become a small workshop or studio. The 160 sq ft unit with a security door feels more like a room than a garage. Our page on units for makers and studios has ideas, and setting up a small workshop covers the basics.

Please check our rules first. Anything that involves melting or heating combustibles, such as candle making, soap making or resin casting, is not allowed. Woodwork, sewing, painting with water-based materials and model making are generally fine. Remember that use other than storage needs our prior approval, and power is standard single-phase.

sections.h2: For mobile businesses based in the area
sections.html:
Mobile businesses such as cleaners, dog groomers, window cleaners, gardeners and mobile mechanics often keep everything in the van and the rest in the garage. A unit gives you a base to restock, store spare equipment and keep paperwork in order.

A 150 sq ft roller-shutter unit at £65 a week (about £282 a month) is often enough for supplies and spares. Remember that bulk fuel, solvent-based chemicals and gas cylinders are not permitted unless agreed in writing. Our page on units for mobile service businesses explores this further.

sections.h2: Something nearby or a unit in central Blackpool
sections.html:
The best choice depends on the job. For things you need weekly or daily, the journey from Thornton-Cleveleys is worth testing before you commit. For long-term storage or a hobby space you visit a few times a week, other factors may matter more:

  • Whether the space has power and Wi-Fi so you can actually use it.
  • Whether there are toilets and somewhere to make a drink. We have both.
  • Access hours. Ours is 24-hour.
  • Whether you can leave at a month's notice. You can here.

sections.h2: Our address and your route
sections.html:
We are at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We do not have a site in Thornton or Cleveleys and we do not collect or deliver.

Every journey is different, so we leave route planning to you. Look up your route on Google Maps from your own address. Units are available from 1 November 2026, with the first week free when you pre-book. For a viewing, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs: Are the units suitable for someone with mobility needs?

All our units are on the ground floor. The storage pods and rooms opening in spring 2027 are on the first floor and reached by stairs. Ask us on WhatsApp about your situation before booking a viewing.
Can I use a unit as a woodwork shop?
Woodwork can be possible with our prior approval. Power is standard single-phase only, so check that your machines suit it.
Can I make candles or soap in a unit?
No. Melting or heating combustibles, including wax, soap bases and resins, is not allowed in the building.
Can I store my late parent's furniture while the family decides what to keep?
Yes. Household furniture and personal belongings are fine. The rent is rolling monthly, so you can give one month's notice once decisions have been made.
Is there a toilet and somewhere to make a drink?
Yes. Tenants share a tea and coffee room, toilets and water in the building.
Do you have storage in Cleveleys?
No. Our only building is on Keswick Road, off Park Road, in central Blackpool.

pages.title: Storage for Fleetwood Residents | The Rock Factory
pages.desc: Honest guide for Fleetwood residents weighing up a storage or business unit in central Blackpool. Rolling monthly terms, 24-hour access, from £65 a week.
h1: an honest look at your options
pages.lead: Fleetwood sits at the northern tip of the Fylde coast, at the opposite end from Lytham. A unit at The Rock Factory can still make sense for some people there, and this guide is honest about when it does and when it does not.

sections.h2: Fleetwood and what its residents need
sections.html:
Fleetwood is a town with a strong identity: a fishing and port heritage, the Marine Hall, its lighthouses, its market and its position on the Wyre estuary. The tram line ends here, and the A585 is the main road into town. It is part of Wyre borough.

The housing includes older terraces near the docks and town centre, and larger homes and newer estates further out. Space at home is as tight here as anywhere, and people store things for all the usual reasons: moving, renovating, downsizing, running a business.

sections.h2: When a unit in central Blackpool makes sense from Fleetwood
sections.html:
We will be straight about this. If you need to visit your storage several times a day, a site close to home is likely to suit you better. But plenty of storage is visited rarely, and for that the journey matters much less.

A unit with us is more likely to work if:

  • You are storing things long-term and will only visit now and then.
  • Your work or daily routine already brings you into Blackpool.
  • You need a workspace with power and Wi-Fi, not just a store.
  • You want a rolling monthly agreement instead of a long lease.

Whatever you decide, check your route from Fleetwood on Google Maps first. We do not quote distances or journey times.

sections.h2: Long-term storage done well
sections.html:
If your things will sit for months at a time, packing them properly is worth the extra effort at the start:

  1. Clean and dry everythingDirt and moisture cause more damage than time does.
  2. Use strong boxes of the same sizeThey stack safely and are easy to label.
  3. Keep air movingLeave a gap between boxes and the walls, and avoid sealing fabrics in plastic.
  4. Make an inventoryKeep a list at home, with photos, so you know what is where without a trip.
  5. Check in occasionallyA visit every so often lets you spot problems early.

Our guides to packing a storage unit and archiving documents go further.

sections.h2: Fishing, boating and outdoor kit
sections.html:
With the sea and the estuary on the doorstep, many Fleetwood households have rods, tackle boxes, waders, wetsuits, kayaks or camping gear. Much of it is seasonal and it takes up a lot of room.

Rinse salt water off kit and let it dry fully before storing it, or you may come back to mould and corrosion. Keep anything with fuel, such as outboard motors or fuel cans, out of the building: bulk fuel is not allowed unless agreed in writing. Rods, tackle, clothing and non-powered craft that fit through the door or shutter are fine.

Our guide on seasonal storage has more on rotating kit between home and unit.

sections.html:
Some Fleetwood businesses already serve customers across the Fylde coast, such as gardeners, landscapers, event suppliers and online sellers. For them, a base in central Blackpool can be practical.

The Rock Factory is at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road, off Park Road, Blackpool FY1 5PB, in central Blackpool. We have no presence in Fleetwood and we do not collect or deliver, so you or a removals firm will bring your things in.

Units are available from 1 November 2026 and pre-bookings get the first week free. If you would like to talk it through honestly before travelling down for a viewing, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs: Is it worth storing things in Blackpool if I live in Fleetwood?

It can be if you will visit rarely, if you are in Blackpool regularly anyway, or if you need a workspace rather than just storage. If you will visit very often, a site closer to home may suit you better.
Can I store a small boat or kayak?
Non-powered kit that fits through the door or roller shutter is fine. Outboard motors and fuel are not allowed in bulk unless agreed in writing. Ask us on WhatsApp if you are unsure.
Can someone else visit the unit for me?
Talk to us about access arrangements before you sign up. The tenant is responsible for the unit and must provide valid government-issued photo ID.
What do I need to bring when I sign up?
Valid government-issued photo ID and a signed Direct Debit mandate, plus one month's rent in advance and a security deposit equal to one month's rent.
Is electricity included in the price?
Electricity is connected in every unit, and usage is charged separately at the supplier rate with no markup. There are no utility deposits.
Do you have a site in Fleetwood?
No. Our only building is on Keswick Road, off Park Road, in central Blackpool FY1 5PB.
